ui.install:
📱 Device check and installation

1. Look for “Add eSIM” in your mobile network settings. Check the manufacturer's website for your exact device model and region. Your phone must be carrier-unlocked.

2. Connect to Wi-Fi before your trip. After purchase, open the QR code on another screen or use the manual setup details in your order. The validity start depends on the plan; read its terms before installing.

3. At your destination, select this eSIM for mobile data and enable data roaming for it. Disable data on your primary SIM and automatic switching between SIMs.

4. Do not delete the eSIM if connectivity is temporarily unavailable. First check the APN from your order and network coverage, then restart your phone. Reinstallation depends on the carrier.

QR code and balance: /orders. Help: /support.
ui.payment_support:
💳 Payment and refund support

Give support your order ID from /orders and describe the issue. If you have been charged, do not pay again. Do not share your Telegram password, banking details or eSIM QR code. Refunds are reviewed under the terms of sale.
